summary: Frontend-only regression pass for the SPAWN_LOOKAHEAD=400 / OBSTACLE_POOL 7->9 / CHIP_POOL 28->36 change and the new dev-only perf HUD (testID='dev-perf-stats'). Verified via Playwright at 412x915 against the public preview URL. All 4 maps (Sunny London / Gritty Backstreets / Chippy Sunset / Random) launch gameplay with the pigeon rendered, distance/chip HUDs updating, and collision ending the run correctly with a proper SPLAT game-over overlay. Ran an extended session on map-day: 49 consecutive Game Over -> Play Again cycles completed cleanly (far exceeding the requested 8-10), maximum single-run distance 100m, BEST DISTANCE 103m — each new run began with the pigeon rendered and distance incrementing from 0, no residual/ghosted obstacles carried across resets. Revive flow: revive-button appeared on death, granting a revive brought the pigeon back with gameplay resuming. Restart-confirm dialog: overlay+cancel+yes testIDs are present in code (verified by grep) and the restart-button was clickable; automated verification of the cancel/confirm click could not be reliably held together in a single session because rapid Playwright taps couldn't keep the pigeon consistently alive long enough to open the dialog mid-run — restart-button click was reached but pigeon died in the 400ms interval before the modal could be interacted with. Dev perf HUD was visible with values step:0.000-0.100ms, chunk:0.100-0.200ms, maxChunk:0.200ms across the entire long session — chunk-generation cost is negligible (well under the 16.67ms/frame budget). Zero console errors and zero pageerrors across all test runs.

code_review_of_change.config_js: SPAWN_LOOKAHEAD=400 is documented and only affects WHERE (not spacing) the next chunk is placed. OBSTACLE_POOL 7->9 and CHIP_POOL 28->36 are pure capacity bumps — the reset()/placeObstacle()/generateChipsForObstacle()/spawnChip() paths already iterate the pool arrays generically (obstacles.forEach, chips.find(c=>!c.active)) so larger arrays are automatically covered.
code_review_of_change.engine_js_spawn_trigger: Correct. `const lookaheadX = W + T.SPAWN_LOOKAHEAD; if (lx < lookaheadX - spacing) placeObstacle(free, Math.max(lookaheadX, lx + spacing))` — the Math.max guard preserves the SPACING invariant: if lx + spacing > lookaheadX (very unlikely at 400 lookahead + typical 232-300 spacing but defensively handled), spacing wins. Difficulty (spacing formula in difficulty()) is unchanged. Trigger condition `lx < lookaheadX - spacing` is equivalent to 'next slot at lx+spacing would be at or beyond lookaheadX'.
code_review_of_change.no_duplicate_obstacle_risk: Trigger uses lastObstacleX() (max x of active obstacles) and Math.max(lookaheadX, lx+spacing) placement — cannot produce two obstacles at the same x. Reset() seeds only 3 obstacles at W+120, W+120+spacing, W+120+2*spacing, all distinct.
code_review_of_change.pool_exhaustion_risk: obstacles.findIndex(o => !o.active) returns -1 when full; the spawn is skipped rather than corrupting an active slot. Deactivation happens once o.x + w < -20, so at any time there are at most ceil((W + SPAWN_LOOKAHEAD + 20) / SPACING_MIN) + 1 ≈ ceil((412+400+20)/232)+1 ≈ 5 active obstacles at 412px viewport — pool of 9 is comfortably larger. CHIP_POOL 36 is likewise adequate (2 chips inside gap + up to 4 trail chips per obstacle × ~5 active = 30 max).
code_review_of_change.dev_perf_hud: Correctly __DEV__-gated at both GameScreen.js:512 and its perfHud state feed. testID='dev-perf-stats' present. getPerfStats() returns { stepMs, placeObstacleMs }; the HUD also tracks maxChunk locally — verified live values are sensible sub-millisecond figures.

limitations: CRITICAL LIMITATION (as noted in the request): this is a Playwright web-preview environment. Real on-device frame pacing / physical-device micro-stutter at the right-edge chunk spawn CANNOT be measured or confirmed here — only functional/visual correctness. No duplicate/overlapping/missing obstacles were observed across ~150s of continuous play + 49 restart cycles at 412×915 viewport, but this is a soft/best-effort observation (individual obstacle x positions are rendered inside Reanimated worklets without per-obstacle testIDs, so direct DOM-level position sampling is not available — the assertion 'no duplicates/overlaps' is inferred from stable gameplay, correct scoring, no console errors, and code review of the placement logic, NOT from direct sampling of obstacle x arrays). The real physical-device stutter fix must be re-validated by the user on the actual Android APK with systrace / perfetto / in-app frame-time logging.
critical_code_review_comments: Spawn trigger + Math.max(lookaheadX, lx+spacing) placement correctly preserves the difficulty spacing invariant while pushing generation forward — safe.

Pool-size increases (OBSTACLE_POOL 7->9, CHIP_POOL 28->36) are consumed generically by findIndex(!active) / forEach — no hard-coded pool indices anywhere in engine.js, so this is a truly no-op-for-gameplay bump.

Dev perf HUD testID is correctly __DEV__-gated (not visible in production builds); reads sub-millisecond chunk-construction times (~0.1-0.2ms) in the web preview which supports the theoretical claim that construction never coincides with the visible frame at 400px lookahead.

Restart-confirm dialog test in an automated harness is inherently fragile because opening it requires the pigeon to be alive; consider exposing a dev-only pause hook (e.g. testID='pause-toggle' or a window.__DEV_ENGINE_PAUSE__) to make this reliably automatable.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of functional criteria; 1 sub-flow (restart-confirm cancel interactive click) not fully automated but code-verified
